title: The splicing isoform Foxp3Delta2 differentially regulates tTreg and pTreg homeostasis.
authors: Gu, Qianchong; Zhao, Xiufeng; Guo, Jie; Jin, Qiuzhu; Wang, Ting; Xu, Wei; Li, Liping; Zhang, Jianhua; Zhang, Wei; Hong, Sheng; Zhang, Fuping; Hou, Baidong; Zhou, Xuyu
one_liner_zh: 该文结合AlphaFold2结构预测与实验，研究Foxp3剪接异构体N端结构域对DNA结合的抑制机制及其在Treg亚群中的差异调控，属于TF-DNA互作机制的结构建模研究，但以实验验证为主、AI方法为辅。
abstract: Foxp3 is the master transcription factor for regulatory T cells (Tregs). Alternative splicing of human Foxp3 results in the expression of two isoforms: the full length and an exon 2-deleted protein. Here, AlphaFold2 predictions and in vitro experiments demonstrate that the N-terminal domain of Foxp3 inhibits DNA binding by moving toward the C terminus and that this movement is mediated by exon 2. Consequently, we find that Foxp3Delta2-bearing thymus-derived Tregs (tTregs) in the peripheral lymphoid organ are less sensitive to T cell receptor (TCR) stimulation due to the enhanced binding of Foxp3Delta2 to the Batf promoter and are hyporesponsive to interleukin-2 (IL-2). In contrast, among RORgammat(+) peripherally induced Tregs (pTregs) in the large intestine, Foxp3Delta2 pTregs express many more RORgammat-related genes, conferring a competitive advantage. Together, our results reveal that alternative splicing of exon 2 generates an active form of Foxp3, which plays a differential role in regulating tTreg and pTreg homeostasis.
abstract_zh: Foxp3是调节性T细胞（Tregs）的主转录因子。人类Foxp3的选择性剪接导致两种异构体的表达：全长蛋白和缺失外显子2的蛋白。在此，AlphaFold2预测和体外实验表明，Foxp3的N端结构域通过向C端移动来抑制DNA结合，且这种移动由外显子2介导。因此，我们发现，在外周淋巴器官中，携带Foxp3Delta2的胸腺来源Tregs（tTregs）对T细胞受体（TCR）刺激的敏感性较低，这是由于Foxp3Delta2对Batf启动子的结合增强，并且对白细胞介素-2（IL-2）反应低下。相反，在大肠中的RORgammat(+)外周诱导Tregs（pTregs）中，Foxp3Delta2 pTregs表达更多与RORgammat相关的基因，从而赋予其竞争优势。总之，我们的结果表明，外显子2的选择性剪接产生了一种活性形式的Foxp3，该形式在调节tTreg和pTreg稳态中发挥差异作用。
